title: A protocol for displaying viral envelope glycoproteins on the surface of vesicular stomatitis viruses
protocol: Detach BHK-21/WI-2 cells using StemPro Accutase Cell Dissociation Reagent.
Count viable cells using trypan blue exclusion dye.
Add 5 × 10^5 cells in 2 mL of DMEM medium to each well of 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells for 24 h at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Change the medium of each well one hour before transfection.
Add 2 mL of medium without FBS and antibiotic to each well.
Transfect the cells with 0.4 μg of Env-expressing plasmid using Effectene according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate the transfected cells for two days before proceeding to the next step.
Remove the media from attached transfected cells on Day 4.
Wash the attached transfected cells three times with PBS to remove dead cells.
Add 500 μL of medium without FBS to each well.
Inoculate each well with scVSV-G (ΔG-luciferase) at an MOI of 3.
Incubate the inoculated wells at 37°C for 1 hour, shaking gently every 15 minutes.
Remove the free scVSV-G virus from cells and wash once with PBS.
Add 2 mL of medium without FBS containing a 1/1000 dilution of anti-VSV-G antibody.
Incubate the infected cells for 24 hours in the tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Transfer the scVSV-containing supernatant to a tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 500 × g.
Collect the virus from the centrifuged sample.
Store the collected virus in aliquots at -80°C.
Seed 2 × 10^4 cells/well target cells in a 96-well white luminometer plate on day 5.
Serially dilute the scVSVs 10-fold in DMEM ranging from 10^-1 to 10^-8 on day 6.
Aspirate the media of each well in the 96-well plate.
Add 100 μL of the diluted scVSVs to the wells in triplicate.
Include a cell control group with no virus to calculate the background level in the luciferase assay.
Incubate the infected cells in the tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration for 6 hours.
Aspirate the media completely from each well.
Add 31 μL of lysis buffer to each well.
Incubate the plate for 20 min at 20°C–25°C.
Measure the firefly luciferase activity using a luminometer.
Design primers for Gibson assembly using online tools or a DNA editor program.
Co-transfect cells with the resulting plasmid containing the VSV genome and heterologous env gene, along with 5 additional plasmids encoding viral proteins and T7 RNA polymerase.
Rescue rcVSVs from transfected cells.
Use rcVSVs for various applications.
Amplify the gene of interest by PCR using a high-fidelity DNA polymerase.
Design primers with a melting temperature (Tm) of 60°C.
Use PfuUltra II Fusion High-fidelity DNA Polymerase according to manufacturer's instructions.
Separate PCR products on a 0.8%–1.2% agarose gel.
Extract the DNA with the correct size using a commercial gel-extraction kit.
Verify the correct size of the amplified DNA.
Set up the Gibson assembly reaction according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 50°C for 15 min.
Transform the reaction products into bacteria.
Incubate the transformed bacteria on LB agar plates containing 50 μg/mL of carbenicillin for 16–20 h at 30°C.
Select 2–3 well-isolated and round colonies from the plate.
Inoculate selected colonies in 2 mL of LB broth containing 50 μg/mL of ampicillin.
Incubate the inoculated bacteria in a shaker incubator for 16–20 h at 30°C.
Extract plasmids using commercial minipreps (e.g., Macherey-Nagel).
Analyze plasmids by restriction enzymes to verify the presence of the env gene.
Sequence the env gene.
Change the media (2 mL) 1 hour before transfection.
Do not include fetal bovine serum (FBS) and antibiotics in the media.
Prepare VSV and supporting plasmids at the specified ratio.
Transfect cells using Effectene with a total of 0.85 μg DNA, 3.2 μL enhancer, and 10 μL Effectene.
Transfer transfected cells into a BSL2+ facility.
Incubate transfected cells for 4 days.
Collect the supernatant after incubation.
Freeze-thaw cells three times to release all viruses from the cells.
Freeze combined fractions at -80°C in aliquots.
Seed 4 × 10^5 BHK-21/WI-2 cells in a 6-well plate.
Transfect the BHK-21/WI-2 cells with pCAGGS-G (0.4 μg/well) using Effectene according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate for 3 days after adding the collected rescue viruses to the transfected cells.
Add all rescued viruses from step 27 to the cells.
Incubate for a total of 3 days after adding 1 mL of media to the existing media.
Seed 4 × 10^5 target cells which express the receptor for the recombinant rcVSVs in a 6-well plate.
Incubate the seeded cells at 37°C for 12–16 hours.
Collect virus from step 30 by centrifugation of supernatants at 800 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Serially dilute collected viruses and add them to a 6-well plate containing target cells prepared in step 31.
Incubate the plate with viruses for 2 hours at 37°C.
Gently shake the plate every 15 minutes during incubation.
Discard media after 2-hour incubation (step 33).
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Prepare 2% low melting agarose by heating in a microwave for 30–45 seconds and keep at 42°C.
Add equal volume of prepared 2% low melting agarose to 2× DMEM media.
Add 2 mL of the mixture to each well.
Incubate for 10–20 minutes at 20°C–25°C to allow agarose solidification.
Incubate infected cells at 37°C for 2 days.
Seed approximately 3 × 10^5 target cells per well in a 6-well plate on Day 12.
Collect well-isolated plaques in the lowest dilutions by puncturing the agarose using a blue pipet tip from Days 13 to 15.
Transfer collected plaque to 200 μL of DMEM and freeze and thaw the viruses three times, each step taking at least 5 minutes.
Add viruses to target cells in each well of the 6-well plate from step 38.
Incubate infected cells for 2–3 days at 37°C and monitor cytopathic effects (CPE).
Passage viruses in target cells for at least three times to increase virus titer, timing approximately four days per passage.
Seed 1 × 10^6 target cells expressing the receptor in a T25 tissue culture flask on Day 1.
Add collected rcVSVs from step 39 to the T25 flask and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C on Days 2–4.
Remove virus and wash once with PBS after incubation.
Add 3 mL of media to each T25 flask supplemented with penicillin-streptomycin antibiotics.
Incubate for no more than 72 hours and monitor daily for the presence of cytopathic effects (CPE).
Collect recombinant vesicular stomatitis viruses (rcVSVs) when approximately 70% of the cells exhibit CPE.
Verify that the VSV genome contains the heterologous env gene by reverse transcription-PCR.
Analyze the level of Env expression in target cells using western blot or immunofluorescence assays.
Extract viral RNA from supernatant of infected cells or directly from infected cells using a commercial kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Use NucleoSpin RNA Virus Kit (Macherey-Nagel) for extraction but note that other kits are also available.
Isolate viral RNA and use it as a template for RT-PCR.
Set up an RT reaction by adding materials in the listed order.
Heat mixture to 65°C for 5 minutes and quickly place on ice.
Centrifuge tube briefly to collect contents.
Add SuperScript II RT after collecting contents.
Incubate at 25°C for 12 minutes, then add SuperScript II RT and incubate at 42°C for 50 minutes.
Inactivate the reaction by incubating at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Collect blood from a BALB/c mouse that was subcutaneously immunized three times, each with 25 μg of soluble SARS-CoV-2 spike protein in 50 μL PBS and mixed with 50 μL AddaVax adjuvant.
Allow the collected blood to clot for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge the clotted blood at 1,000–2,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Transfer the top, clear serum fraction to a 1.5 mL tube.
Seed 2 × 104 cells/well of 293T-ACE2 target cells in a 96-well white luminometer plate.
Make serial dilutions of the serum on Day 2 (e.g., 1:40, 1:200, 1:1,000, 1:5,000) in DMEM.
Mix diluted serum with an equal volume of scVSV-2S-del18.luc.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add 100 μL of the serum-virus mixture to the 293T-ACE2 target cells.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 6–20 hours.
Measure luciferase activity as described in Ratnapriya et al. 2020.
